mainText: Two goals in two games - Sesko gives Man Utd a different threat. Benjamin Sesko's return to Manchester United's starting line-up is well timed ahead of Sunday's Premier League encounter with Manchester City Sutton's predictions v Dorking Wanderers manager Marc White. BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on Dorking Wanderers manager Marc White, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures. Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes. Test your ball knowledge against Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Spies, strategies and missed opportunities: How the lessons of 9/11 are still being learnt. Twenty-five years on, the attacks have come to define a generation of foreign, security and intelligence policy, the BBC's security correspondent writes. AI boom helps drive surprise UK growth in July. The economy expanded by 0.4%, official figures show, whereas analysts had predicted no growth. Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons. The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity. Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction. Auction house Sotheby's expects the dress to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000) when it goes under the hammer on 9 December.
